summary: THIRTEEN NEW ANCHORS OVER THIRTEEN TARGET ROWS (53-65), the whole of Second Season part 1, and all thirteen CONFIRMED CANON — no retype, no anchor_hostile row, no repair. THE BLOCK COVERS ch 170-259, which is MangaUpdates' claim for this part exactly; but MU was a cross-check, not the premise, and the pages moved the shape inside it: the season does NOT open where ep 52 stopped. Ep 53 opens on ch 189 and plays the whole Seidou vs Norikane 5th-round game to ch 197, and only THEN do eps 54 and 55 go back to ch 170 for the Ichidaisan vs Yakushi 5th-round game the manga tells first — an un-cross-cut that puts Seidou in the premiere, annotated `rearranged` on both rows and carrying the one END regression in the block (ep 54 -> 180 after ep 53 -> 197). The map: 53 -> 197 [189], 54 -> 180 [170], 55 -> 187 [181], 56 -> 216 [198], 57 -> 222 [217], 58 -> 227 [223], 59 -> 232 [228], 60 -> 236 [233], 61 -> 240 [237], 62 -> 245 [241], 63 -> 251 [246], 64 -> 254 [252], 65 -> 259 [255]. Ten anchors are high confidence and three medium (56, 57, 61 — the derived seams). The instrument that made the interior seams derivable is a CHAIN: eleven of the thirteen episode titles are their own chapters' titles verbatim, and every episode's next-episode teaser names content the following episode's licensor あらすじ opens on, so each seam is closed from both sides — e.g. ep 58 opens on Miyuki's 「よし、初っ端からかましとくか！　奴らの頭にない球種「ナンバー９」」, which is ch 223's own line, and ep 65 closes on Kawakami's 精密検査 result, which is ch 259's. FIRST FOUR ROWS ARE COMPRESSED, annotated `abridged`: 47 chapters in four episodes (ep 56 alone carries the entire Seidou vs Sousei quarter-final, 204-216, plus the other quarter-final blocks), against 4.8 chapters an episode from ep 57 on. TWO CONTINUES, both C2 parity across the reorder: ep 53 -> 170 and ep 55 -> 198; ep 65 gets none, because 259 is not straddled and Part 2 is undated. ONE HONEST HOLE: a single chapter of the block (188, Seidou's team meeting plus the scouting report on Amahisa's new pitch) is placed by nothing — the reorder makes both of its halves redundant, so a cut is the economical reading, but it is flagged rather than assigned. Stored titles and air dates all match ja-WP, en-WP and the official site, so repairs is empty; the ep-52 graft naming ch 189 is now corroborated by the fandom's own match record.

anchors.why: NEW ANCHOR, the season's first row. THE EPISODE IS THE WHOLE SEIDOU vs NORIKANE (法兼学園) 5th-round game. START 189 / END 197 (A4): three lineages give the same span. (1) diamondnoace.fandom's episode page 'To What Lies Ahead' states it in words: 'The episode follows the storyline from chapter 189 to chapter 197 of the Act II manga' (written by PerseusHunt on broadcast day, 2026-04-05, per the page history). (2) The same wiki's match record independently books that game at 'Act II, Chapter 189-197' on BOTH the per-match page ('Norikane Academy vs. Seidou High', which also carries anime = 'Episode 52, Season 3 - TBC', i.e. the act II finale's teaser) and the Round-Five table of 'List of Baseball Matches/Act II'. (3) TITLE IDENTITY: the episode's own title 「その先へ」 IS ch 197's title (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第22巻 Chapter 197 「その先へ」 Sono saki e), and ch 197 is the game's last chapter — the Japanese per-chapter blog イノさんの漫画アニメ heads its ch-197 post 「第22巻197話（法兼9）ネタバレ感想：試合終了」 (game part 9, game over). CONTENT: the licensor's own あらすじ (diaace.com/story/1/, reproduced verbatim by Bandai Channel and paraphrased by WEBザテレビジョン) is 「全国高等学校野球選手権 西東京代表を決める5回戦、青道VS法兼学園。先発はこの夏よりエースナンバーを背負う沢村栄純。…プレイボール！」 and ja-WP's act II summer bracket lists 五回戦 青道○13-0●法兼学園（五回コールド） — a nine-chapter, five-inning called game compressed into one 22-minute premiere (see the `abridged` annotation). WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT — the game is the whole episode. VOLUME 22: ch 197 sits in vol 22 (193-201) on the fandom's Volumes/Act II table AND on the Japanese blog's own per-post volume label 「第22巻197話」 — two independent readings of the tankōbon contents. THE ONE SOFT EDGE, stated: ch 188 「期待の表れ」 (Watanabe's report on Amahisa's new pitch + Seidou's full team meeting the night before this game) is not placed by any source — it could open this episode; and ch 198 「次の相手」 (learning the QF opponent is Sousei) could tail it instead of opening ep 56. Neither is claimed here; both are named in structure.notes and flagged.

NEW ANCHOR — and the BACK-JUMP row (see the `rearranged` annotation). The episode is the FIRST HALF of the OTHER 5th-round game, 市大三高 (Ichidaisan) vs 薬師 (Yakushi), which the manga tells BEFORE Seidou's own 5th-round game but the anime plays AFTER it. START 170 (A10): two independent lineages. (1) MangaUpdates' curated coverage for this entry reads anime.start 'Vol 1, Chap 1 (S1) / Vol 19, Chap 170 (S2P1) / Vol 30, Chap 260 (S2P2)' — 170 is the season's own start pin, and it is the chapter immediately after the stored ep-52 END (169), so nothing between the seasons is stranded. (2) CONTENT: the per-episode Japanese review (yanaginaya.com #2) opens with 「やりとりをする沢村：市大三高の天久とやり取りをする沢村」 and 「新球種の正体：曲がりきらないスライダー…ジャイロ回転」 — that LINE exchange between Amahisa and Sawamura and the gyro-spin hint about Amahisa's new pitch are ch 170 (blog: 「第19巻170話：薬師と市大三高の試合前日」, which ends on Amahisa's LINE) and ch 171 (「第19巻171話：市大三高のミーティング」, which carries the カットボール/ジャイロ回転 hints and Ichidaisan's pre-game meeting) — i.e. the episode opens on the two lead-in chapters, then plays the game from 172. END 180 (A4): the episode's own title 「チームの為に」 IS ch 180's title (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第20巻 Chapter 180 「チームの為に」 Chīmu no tame ni), and the episode's NEXT-EPISODE PREVIEW as reported in the same review — 「轟と天久の対決が熱い…チャンスの打席でプレッシャーを感じる雷市に、ふたりで決めようと伝える真田」 — is Raichi vs Amahisa, which is ch 181-183 (blog: 181 「轟VS天久」, 182 「天久VS轟～決着～」). So the episode stops with the top of the 8th opened (ch 180 = 「８回表の薬師」 per the same blog) and hands Raichi's at-bat to ep 55. The game itself is 172-187 on the fandom's match page ('Act II, Chapter 171-187') and its Round-Five table ('Chapters 172-187'). WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 20: ch 180 ∈ vol 20 (175-183) on the fandom table and on the blog's own 「第20巻180話」 label; ja-WP's character notes independently cite 'actII 第20巻第183話' and 'actII 第19巻第172話/第173話', which fix the same two volume edges.

NEW ANCHOR — the second half of the Ichidaisan vs Yakushi 5th-round game, i.e. the return leg of the reorder. START 181 / END 187 (A4). END 187 is the game's LAST chapter on two readings: the fandom's match record ('Act II, Chapter 171-187' on the match page; 'Chapters 172-187' in the Round-Five table) and the Japanese per-chapter blog, whose ch-187 post is headed 「第21巻187話：市大三高の勝利」 and describes the 9th-inning walk-off (2 out, runners on 1st and 3rd, Chimaru's hit) that ends it. TITLE IDENTITY: the episode's title 「勝者の道」 IS ch 187's title (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第21巻 Chapter 187 「勝者の道」 Shōsha no michi). CONTENT: the licensor's あらすじ (diaace.com/story/3/) frames the episode from the situation 「三回裏、薬師・エースの真田がマウンドに…七回が終わり、2-0で市大三高がリード」 and then gives the episode's actual content, 「しかし、雷市がここで終わるわけがない！」 — Raichi's 8th-inning heroics onward; ja-WP's bracket gives the result 市大三○3-2●薬師 and the fandom's inning table shows Yakushi's 2 runs in the 8th and Ichidaisan's walk-off in the 9th, i.e. exactly the span 181-187 (blog: 181 轟VS天久, 182 天久VS轟～決着～, 183 ４番三島, 184 ピッチャーの明暗, 185 天久の打席, 186 やっちまった, 187 市大三高の勝利). The per-episode review (yanaginaya #3) matches beat for beat: 「打たれた後に素直に雷市がすごかっただけと称える天久」「まだ投げられるのか素直に聞く監督」「投げる真田を見てかっこいいと言う天久」「動けない雷市に言葉をかける真田」. START 181 is the complement of ep 54's END and carries no relocated opener (A12 not engaged). WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 21: ch 187 ∈ vol 21 (184-192) on the fandom table and on the blog's 「第21巻187話」 label; ja-WP independently cites 'actII 第21巻 第192話'.

NEW ANCHOR — the quarter-final round, and the single most compressed row of the cour: nineteen chapters, including the ENTIRE Seidou vs Sousei quarter-final, in one episode (see the `abridged` annotation). START 198 (A10): ch 198 is 「次の相手」 / blog 「第22巻198話ネタバレ感想：準々決勝は創聖高校」 — Seidou learns the QF opponent is Sousei, which is where the licensor's あらすじ opens the episode: 「ベスト4をかけた試合が続々と始まる。成孔×稲城実業…そして青道の次なる相手は創聖高校。先発マウンドには降谷が登る」. The other QFs it then shows are the fandom's 'Inashiro Industrial vs. Seiko Academy 10-0 (Act II - Chapters 199-200)' and 'Ichidaisan High vs. Sensen Academy 7-3 (Chapters 201-202)' (blog: 201/202 「仙泉学園ＶＳ市大三高」), matching the review's 「試合を見に行く沢村」. END 216 (A4): the Seidou vs Sousei QF runs 204-216 (fandom match page: 'Act II, Chapter 204-216'; the blog labels ch 204 創聖戦1 「『創聖高校』戦試合開始」 through ch 216 創聖戦13 「抑えの川上」) and ch 216 is the final out — an independent Japanese ネタバレ page for ch 216 「守護神」 describes the 9th inning with Kawakami coming in as closer, striking out the batter and ending the game 7-1. The per-episode review (yanaginaya #4) carries exactly that arc — 「ついに降谷が登板。155キロ…チームメイトのナイスプレーに素直に拍手する降谷…川上への信頼感もいい」 — and its next-episode teaser is 「次の試合はいよいよ沢村が登板」, i.e. the QF is finished. TITLE IDENTITY: the episode's title on the OFFICIAL site and Bandai Channel is 「豪音」, which IS ch 207's title (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第23巻 Chapter 207 「豪音」 Gōon; blog: 創聖戦4 「投手戦」) — mid-episode, not the END (ja-WP and en-WP print 「轟音」 for this row, a different character; see flags). MEDIUM because no source states the range: START 198 and END 216 are both derived (198 could tail ep 53; ch 217, the post-game with Nara's handshake and the OB, is placed in ep 57 here but could close ep 56). WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT — all nineteen chapters are source. VOLUME 24: ch 216 ∈ vol 24 (211-219) on the fandom table and on the blog's 「第24巻216話」 label; ja-WP independently cites 'actII 第24巻218話' and '第24巻第219話', and Kodansha's own vol-24 copy describes 「息詰まる投手戦となった青道vs.創聖の中盤戦…打席には…エース・柳楽…降谷は春からの成長を証明できるのか」.

NEW ANCHOR — the interlude between the quarter-final and the semi-final. END 222 IS CONFIRMED VERBATIM: the Japanese per-chapter blog's ch-222 post (「第25巻222話ネタバレ感想：川上の怪我」) contains BOTH of this episode's closing threads — Kawakami's arm (Tanba and Furuya notice, the hospital, 「筋肉か腱の部分的損傷の可能性/骨に異常はない/後日MRI」, and his plea 「野球は高校で最後でいい…お願いします！投げさせてください！」) AND Ichidaisan's pre-game scene with Amahisa telling his team 「俺はお前らを甲子園で見たい」. The per-episode review (yanaginaya #5) has exactly those two, as its 「負傷した川上」 section (「病院に行くように言ったのが丹波」「投げずに後悔するぐらいなら、投げて壊れてもいい」) and its 「天久の変化」 section (「試合前のチームメイトへの言葉も実に天久らしい」). The licensor's あらすじ opens the episode on the other thread — 「奥村と投球動作や新球の確認…試したい握りがいくつかある…一方そのころ、川上は右腕の感覚が…」 — which is ch 219 「持ち球」 and ch 220 「プレゼンテーション」 (blog ch 220: 「沢村、戦略を練る」; the review: 「しっかりプレゼン仕切り、変化球を試した沢村」) running into ch 221 「違和感」, the episode's TITLE chapter (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第25巻 Chapter 221 「違和感」 Iwakan) — mid-episode, not the END. The graduated OB thread the review also reports (「卒業した先輩たちがやってきて…テツさんに足を褒められて…倉持」) is ch 219 「真中先輩が応援に」 and ch 221 「卒業した先輩たち」 in the blog's headings. START 217 is the softer edge and is why this row is MEDIUM: ch 217 (創聖戦14, Nara's handshake with Miyuki and the Ryosuke/Chris visit after the Sousei game) is placed at the head of this episode because ep 56's review reports the game only to its final out while this episode's review carries the senpai material; no source states it, and 217 could instead close ep 56. WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 25: ch 222 ∈ vol 25 (220-228) on the fandom table and on the blog's own 「第25巻222話」 label; Kodansha's vol-25 copy independently opens 「西東京大会準決勝を前に、ＯＢの激励を受ける青道ナイン達」 — the OB visit is this volume's opening material.

NEW ANCHOR — the semi-final (青道 vs 市大三高) begins. START 223 IS CONFIRMED VERBATIM. The blog's ch-223 post (「第25巻223話ネタバレ感想：準決勝の日の朝」) is the morning of 7月26日 at Jingu, the OB and family in the stands, Kawakami ruled out for the game, Seidou winning the toss and taking 後攻, and Miyuki's line 「よし、初っ端からかましとくか！　奴らの頭にない球種「ナンバー９」」 — and the per-episode review (yanaginaya #6) opens with 「川上の決意を受け止める監督」 and then 「御幸のしょっぱなカマしとくかの言葉で表情が崩れるのがいい」, the same line. END 227 (A4): the review closes the episode on 「市大三高の四番に御幸の要求どおりの球を長打されることに…無死二塁のピンチをどう乗り越えるのか」 — Hoshida's deep drive with none out — which is ch 227 (blog: 「227話（市大三高4）：星田の粘り強いバッティング」); the NEXT episode's licensor あらすじ picks up from exactly that state (「二回表…ノーアウトでランナー二塁、迎えるバッターは5番佐々木」), so the seam sits at the chapter boundary and no C1 straddle applies. TITLE IDENTITY: 「お披露目」 IS ch 224's title (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第25巻 Chapter 224 「お披露目」 Ohirome) — here the episode's SECOND chapter, the unveiling of Sawamura's revised splitter 'number 9'; the fandom's semi-final page opens its First Inning with 'Miyuki asks for number 9 — the revised Splitter right from the first pitch'. The game as a whole is 'Act II, Chapter 224 - 253' on the fandom's semi-final page and 'Chapters 224-253' in its Semifinals table, and the blog numbers it 市大三高1 (ch 224) … 市大三高30 (ch 253) — a 30-chapter game, exactly. WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 25: ch 227 ∈ vol 25 (220-228) on the fandom table; the blog's per-post volume labels run 第25巻 through ch 223 and its index groups 220-228 as vol 25.

NEW ANCHOR. START 228 (A10): the licensor's あらすじ opens the episode 「二回表、市大三高に先制のチャンスがまわってきた。ノーアウトでランナー二塁、迎えるバッターは5番佐々木」, which is ch 228 (blog: 「228話（市大三高5）：２回表市大三高の攻撃」) — the chapter that also gives the episode its TITLE, 「積み上げてきたもの」 (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第25巻 Chapter 228 「積み上げてきたもの」 Tsumiagete Kita Mono). END 232 (A4): the per-episode review (yanaginaya #7) walks the episode through the top of the 2nd jam (228), Miyuki leading off the bottom of the 2nd and being called out looking (ch 229 「天久VS御幸」), Sawamura's 140 km/h in the 3rd (ch 230 「市大三高の攻撃」), and Seidou's bottom of the 3rd — Kanemaru's long hit, Sawamura's sacrifice bunt, then 「二死三塁で迎えたのは倉持。天久と倉持の心理戦」 — which is ch 232 (blog: 「232話（市大三高9）：倉持の打席」), the third out of the inning; its next-episode teaser is 「お互いに無得点のまま試合は中盤へ」 and the NEXT episode's licensor あらすじ opens at 四回表, i.e. ch 233. The fandom's semi-final page corroborates the inning content beat for beat (Second Inning: Hoshida/Sasaki's bunt/Adachi; Third Inning: Sawamura's 140 km record, Kanemaru's hit, Sawamura's bunt, Kuramochi out). WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 26: ch 232 ∈ vol 26 (229-237) on the fandom's Volumes/Act II table and in the Japanese blog's own volume index; ja-WP independently cites 'actII 第26巻第230話'.

NEW ANCHOR — one half-inning as a whole episode. START 233 (A10): the licensor's あらすじ is 「四回表の三高の攻撃、リズムよく沢村が投げる中、ファースト前園のエラーでランナーが二塁へ。迎えるバッターは二回に続き、4番の星田」 — Maezono's error putting the runner on second is ch 233 (blog: 「233話（市大三高10）：エラーでピンチ」). END 236 (A4): the per-episode review (yanaginaya #8) says 「ほぼ三高の攻撃だけで丸々1話」 and ends the episode past the first run and on Amahisa's reaction — 「ピンチを迎える天久：1点取って勝ったっという天久…チームメイトのことを思うからこそ、今までの天久にはなかった力みが」 — which is ch 236 (blog: 「236話（市大三高13）：天久崩れる！？」); its next-episode teaser 「チャンスで迎えた御幸の打席」 is ch 237 (blog: 「237話（市大三高14）：天久と御幸の勝負」), which is where the NEXT episode's licensor あらすじ starts. Kodansha's own volume copy fixes the same seam from the other side: vol 26 (229-237) is sold as ending on 「鍵となる先制点を奪ったのは──」 and vol 27 (238-) opens 「ついに均衡が破られた４回。試合は中盤戦に突入する」. TITLE IDENTITY: 「エースの理念」 IS ch 234's title (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第26巻 Chapter 234 「エースの理念」 Ēsu no Rinen), mid-episode — the fandom's semi-final page puts Sawamura's thoughts on 'what type of ace he aims to be' in this very half-inning, at the Hoshida strikeout. WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 26 on both volume readings.

NEW ANCHOR. START 237 (A10): the licensor's あらすじ is 「先制を許した青道。四回裏の攻撃で追いつきたい青道は、ランナーを一・二塁において打席に主砲・御幸が。ここまで好調の天久は渾身のカットボールを投げ込む。御幸のバットがボールを捉えるが…」 — Miyuki batting with runners on first and second in the bottom of the 4th, which is ch 237 (blog: 「237話（市大三高14）：天久と御幸の勝負」); the fandom's semi-final page has Haruichi's leadoff single and Shirasu's walk (the end of ep 60's ch 236, 「天久崩れる！？」) and then Miyuki's 3-6-1 double play. END 240 (A4): the per-episode review (yanaginaya #9) calls this a 「ナレーション多めの紙芝居回」 in which 「ナレーション多めで一気に進む試合」 — innings 5 to 7 pass quickly, as they do in the manga — and its next-episode teaser is 「試合はいよいよ終盤…川上がブルペンで投げるようですが果たして登板はあるのでしょうか」, i.e. ch 242 「川上も投げたい」; the NEXT episode's licensor あらすじ opens 「七回裏、青道はノーアウトランナー一塁と反撃の糸口が。打席に入るのは東条」, with Maezono ALREADY on base, so the leadoff hit closes this episode inside ch 240 (blog: 「240話（市大三高17）：７回の攻防」) and Toujou/Yuki/Kanemaru — 青道の下位打線, ch 241 — belong to ep 62. MEDIUM because that 240/241 split is read off the blog's chapter headings and the two synopses rather than stated by any source. TITLE IDENTITY: 「High Voltage」 IS ch 239's title (fandom Volumes/Act II and Chapters/Act II both give Chapter 239 'High Voltage'), mid-episode. WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 27: ch 240 ∈ vol 27 on BOTH volume readings of the tankōbon (the fandom's 238-247 and the Japanese blog index's 238-246), and Kodansha's vol-27 copy — 「ついに均衡が破られた４回。試合は中盤戦に突入するも、青道ナインは天久攻略の糸口をつかめずにいた」 — is this episode's material exactly.

NEW ANCHOR. START 241 (A10): the licensor's あらすじ 「七回裏、青道はノーアウトランナー一塁と反撃の糸口が。打席に入るのは東条。セーフティバントを狙う。そして続くバッターは…結城将司！」 is ch 241 (blog: 「241話（市大三高18）：青道の下位打線」 — Toujou 6th, Yuki 7th, Kanemaru 8th), and the fandom's semi-final page has the same order in the bottom of the 7th. END 245 (A4): the per-episode review (yanaginaya #10) carries Kawakami going to the bullpen without a ball to lift the mood (ch 242 「川上も投げたい」 / 243 「エールを送る川上」), Sawamura's precision rising late — the top of the 8th, where the fandom page has him strike out the side with Furuya warming up (ch 244 「降谷、ブルペンで投球練習」) — and ends on 「打席で粘る沢村。自分だったら先頭打者に粘られたくないと投手目線で」, Sawamura leading off the bottom of the 8th, which is ch 245 (blog: 「245話（市大三高22）：９番沢村、１番倉持」). Its next-episode teaser 「一度は刺されているのに盗塁を決める倉持。打席には春市」 is ch 246 (blog: 「246話（市大三高23）：同点に追いつけるか！？」), which the next episode's licensor あらすじ then opens on. TITLE IDENTITY: 「俺の戦い」 IS ch 242's title (fandom Volumes/Act II, 第27巻 Chapter 242 「俺の戦い」 Ore no Tatakai), mid-episode. WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT. VOLUME 27 on both volume readings.

NEW ANCHOR — the bottom of the 8th, the comeback. START 246 (A10): the licensor's あらすじ 「八回表を3人でピシャリと抑えた沢村。八回裏の攻撃、倉持が盗塁を決め二塁に…春市、そして好打者の白州。御幸に繋げたい青道と、繋げたくない三高」 opens on Kuramochi's steal with Haruichi at the plate — ch 246 (blog: 「246話（市大三高23）：同点に追いつけるか！？」) — its first sentence being a recap of the top of the 8th that ep 62 already played.
